ORDER NO. 9852 
EXTENDING DEADLINES FOR STAFF AND 
DIVISION OF PUBLIC ADVOCATE DIRECT 
TESTIMONY AND RELATED DISCOVERY 

WHEREAS, on June 23, 2021, the Commission entered Order No. 9831, which (a) 
appointed the undersigned to serve as Hearing Examiner for this Docket, and (b) adopted a 
procedural schedule related to proceedings in this Docket; 
WHEREAS, by email message sent to the Hearing Examiner on August 3, 2021, on behalf 
of Applicants, Veolia Environment S.A., Veolia North America, Inc., SUEZ S.A., and SUEZ 
Water Delaware Inc. (collectively the “Joint Applicants”), Commission Staff (“Staff”), and the 
Division of the Public Advocate (“DPA”), counsel advised that the Joint Applicants, Staff and the 
DPA anticipate engaging in settlement discussions, as contemplated by Order No. 9831, and the 
parties jointly request that certain deadlines in the procedural schedule be adjusted to accommodate 
such discussions; 
WHEREAS, the modifications to deadlines as jointly proposed by the parties will not affect 
the hearing dates or other deadlines set pursuant to Order No. 9831; 

2 

WHEREAS, counsel for the Joint Applicants, Staff and the DPA all agree that the Hearing 
Examiner is authorized to revise the procedural schedule as requested, by virtue of the powers 
delegated to the Hearing Examiner in Paragraph 2 of Order No. 9831, and under Section 1.9.2 of 
the Rules of Practice and Procedure of the Commission, 26 Del. Admin. Code § 1001-1.9.2; and 
WHEREAS, there is good cause to extend the deadline for the filing of testimony by Staff 
and DPA, and the subsequent deadlines for discovery and rebuttal testimony, 

NOW, THEREFORE, this 3rd day of August, 2021, pursuant to the authority granted to 
me in PSC Order No. 9831, dated June 23, 2021, this Hearing Examiner, having considered the 
application of the Joint Applicants, Staff and DPA as described above, orders as follows: 
1. 
The joint request of the Joint Applicants, Staff and DPA to extend the deadline for 
the submission and filing of direct testimony by DPA and Staff, and to extend related testimony 
and discovery deadlines, as further specified in Paragraph 2 of this Order, is granted. 
2. 
The schedule for the submission of direct testimony by Staff and DPA, related 
discovery and rebuttal testimony is modified as set forth below:
